result.reason: The redline adds the required annual frequency limit, business-hours restriction, 30-day written notice, auditor confidentiality, and prohibition on direct or remote systems access. However, the cost shift remains triggered by any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than an underpayment exceeding 5%, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. It also unnecessarily relocates the cost paragraph and retains a potentially conflicting requirement that the audit be permitted within 30 days despite requiring at least 30 days’ prior notice. Unrelated commercial intent is otherwise preserved.
